Nudist_0.Name: Nudist
Nudist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the feeling of freedom that comes from being nude. {PAWN_pronoun} can handle clothing, but will be happier without it.

Bloodlust_0.Name: Bloodlust
Bloodlust_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} gets a rush from hurting people, and never minds the sight of blood or death. {PAWN_pronoun} is four times as likely to start a social fight as others.

Kind_0.Name: Kind
Kind_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is an exceptionally agreeable and giving person. {PAWN_pronoun} rarely insults others and will sometimes offer kind words to brighten the moods of those around {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} also never judges people by their appearance. {PAWN_possessive} agreeableness also makes {PAWN_objective} more likely to conform to prevailing opinions.

Psychopath_0.Name: Psychopath
Psychopath_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has no empathy. The suffering of others doesn't bother {PAWN_objective} at all. {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't mind if others are butchered, left unburied, imprisoned, or sold to slavery - unless it affects {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} also feels no mood boost from socializing.

Cannibal_0.Name: Cannibal
Cannibal_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} was taught that eating human meat is wrong and horrible. But one time, long ago, {PAWN_pronoun} tried it... and {PAWN_pronoun} liked it.

Abrasive_0.Name: Abrasive
Abrasive_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} always says exactly what's on {PAWN_possessive} mind, especially if it's bugging {PAWN_objective}. That tends to rub people the wrong way.

TooSmart_0.Name: Too smart
TooSmart_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is too smart for {PAWN_possessive} own good. {PAWN_pronoun} learns everything much faster than everyone, but can be quite eccentric.

Brawler_0.Name: Brawler
Brawler_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} likes to fight up close and personal. {PAWN_possessive} accuracy is greatly increased in melee combat, but {PAWN_pronoun}'ll be very unhappy if asked to carry a ranged weapon.

Masochist_0.Name: Masochist
Masochist_0.Description: For {PAWN_nameDef}, there's something exciting about getting hurt. {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't know why, {PAWN_pronoun}'s just wired differently.

NightOwl_0.Name: Night owl
NightOwl_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} likes to be up during the night, and sleep during the day.

{PAWN_pronoun} gets a mood bonus if awake at night (23h-6h) and mood loss if awake during the day (11h-18h).

{PAWN_pronoun} doesn't get a mood penalty for being in the dark.

Greedy_0.Name: Greedy
Greedy_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} needs a really impressive bedroom. {PAWN_pronoun} gets a mood loss if {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't get what {PAWN_pronoun} wants.

Jealous_0.Name: Jealous
Jealous_0.Description: For {PAWN_nameDef}, it's degrading to have a less impressive bedroom than someone else. {PAWN_pronoun} gets a mood loss if any colonist has a more impressive bedroom.

Ascetic_0.Name: Ascetic
Ascetic_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has forsaken physical comforts and enjoyments in favor of a simple, pure lifestyle. {PAWN_pronoun} will become unhappy if {PAWN_pronoun} has a bedroom that's too impressive. {PAWN_pronoun} also dislikes fancy food and prefers to eat raw. {PAWN_pronoun} never judges others by their appearance.

Gay_0.Name: Gay
Gay_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is romantically attracted to people of {PAWN_possessive} own gender.

Bisexual_0.Name: Bisexual
Bisexual_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is romantically attracted to both men and women.

Asexual_0.Name: Asexual
Asexual_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has no sexual attraction to anyone at all.

AnnoyingVoice_0.Name: Annoying voice
AnnoyingVoice_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s voice has a particularly grating, nasal quality to it, and {PAWN_pronoun} tends to talk in barked, garbled phrases. This predisposes others to dislike {PAWN_objective}.

CreepyBreathing_0.Name: Creepy breathing
CreepyBreathing_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} breathes heavily all the time, and sweats constantly. People find it creepy.

Pyromaniac_0.Name: Pyromaniac
Pyromaniac_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} loves fire. {PAWN_pronoun} will never extinguish fires, and will occasionally go on random fire starting sprees. {PAWN_pronoun} will be happy around flames, and happier when wielding an incendiary weapon.

Wimp_0.Name: Wimp
Wimp_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is weak and cowardly. Even a little pain will immobilize {PAWN_objective}.

Nimble_0.Name: Nimble
Nimble_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has remarkable kinesthetic intelligence. {PAWN_pronoun} seems to dance around danger with preternatural grace.

FastLearner_0.Name: Fast learner
FastLearner_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a knack for learning. {PAWN_pronoun} picks things up much faster than others.

SlowLearner_0.Name: Slow learner
SlowLearner_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is slow on the uptake. {PAWN_pronoun} learns much slower than others.

Undergrounder_0.Name: Undergrounder
Undergrounder_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has no need to experience the outdoors or light. {PAWN_pronoun} will never feel cooped up or get cabin fever and is not bothered by darkness. However, {PAWN_nameDef} will be unhappy while outdoors.

Transhumanist_0.Name: Body modder
Transhumanist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} feels limited in {PAWN_possessive} feeble human body. {PAWN_pronoun} often dreams of being enhanced with artificial body parts or xenogenetics.

BodyPurist_0.Name: Body purist
BodyPurist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes the human body is limited for a reason. To {PAWN_objective}, artificial body parts and xenogenes are unethical and disgusting.

GreatMemory_0.Name: Great memory
GreatMemory_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a fantastic memory for detail. {PAWN_pronoun} will lose unused skills at half the rate of other people.

Tough_0.Name: Tough
Tough_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has thick skin, dense flesh, and durable bones. {PAWN_pronoun} takes much less damage than other people from the same blows. {PAWN_pronoun} is extremely hard to kill.

TorturedArtist_0.Name: Tortured artist
TorturedArtist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} feels alienated and misunderstood by other human beings. {PAWN_pronoun} will have a constant mood debuff, but gain a chance (50%) to get a creativity inspiration after a mental break.

Gourmand_0.Name: Gourmand
Gourmand_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s life revolves around food. {PAWN_pronoun} gets hungry quickly, and will occasionally be overcome with the urge to eat ravenously, even when not hungry.

QuickSleeper_0.Name: Quick sleeper
QuickSleeper_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} doesn't need as much sleep as the average person. Whether {PAWN_pronoun}'s sleeping on a bed or on the ground, {PAWN_pronoun} will be fully rested in about two thirds the usual time.

SpeedOffset_-1.Name: Slowpoke
SpeedOffset_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] is always falling behind the group whenever [PAWN_pronoun] goes anywhere.

SpeedOffset_1.Name: Fast walker
SpeedOffset_1.Description: [PAWN_name] likes to be where [PAWN_pronoun]'s going. [PAWN_pronoun] walks quicker than most people.

SpeedOffset_2.Name: Jogger
SpeedOffset_2.Description: [PAWN_name] always moves with a sense of urgency - so much so that others often fail to keep up.

DrugDesire_2.Name: Chemical fascination
DrugDesire_2.Description: [PAWN_name] is utterly fascinated with chemical sources of enjoyment. Consuming recreational drugs will create a good mood, while abstaining will lead to increasing frustration over time and possibly drug binges. [PAWN_pronoun] will ignore directives to not use recreational drugs, and will consume more than a normal person.

DrugDesire_1.Name: Chemical interest
DrugDesire_1.Description: [PAWN_name] has an unusual interest in chemical sources of enjoyment. Consuming recreational drugs will create a good mood, while abstaining will lead to increasing frustration over time and possible drug binges. [PAWN_pronoun] will ignore directives to not use recreational drugs, and will consume more than a normal person.

DrugDesire_-1.Name: Teetotaler
DrugDesire_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] abhors the idea of gaining pleasure from chemicals. [PAWN_pronoun] strictly avoids alcohol and recreational drugs.

NaturalMood_2.Name: Sanguine
NaturalMood_2.Description: [PAWN_name] is just naturally upbeat about [PAWN_possessive] situation, pretty much all the time, no matter what it is.

NaturalMood_1.Name: Optimist
NaturalMood_1.Description: [PAWN_name] is naturally optimistic about life. It's hard to get [PAWN_objective] down.

NaturalMood_-1.Name: Pessimist
NaturalMood_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] tends to look on the bad side of life.

NaturalMood_-2.Name: Depressive
NaturalMood_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] is perenially unhappy. [PAWN_pronoun] has trouble sustaining a good mood even when everything is fine.

Nerves_2.Name: Iron-willed
Nerves_2.Description: [PAWN_name]'s will is an iron shield. [PAWN_pronoun] keeps going through thick and thin, when others broke down long before.

Nerves_1.Name: Steadfast
Nerves_1.Description: [PAWN_name] is mentally tough and won't break down under stresses that would crack most people.

Nerves_-2.Name: Volatile
Nerves_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] is on a hair-trigger all the time. [PAWN_pronoun] is the first to break in any tough situation.

Neurotic_1.Name: Neurotic
Neurotic_1.Description: [PAWN_name] likes to have things squared away. [PAWN_pronoun] will work harder than most to attain this state of affairs, but [PAWN_possessive] nerves can get the better of [PAWN_objective].

Neurotic_2.Name: Very neurotic
Neurotic_2.Description: [PAWN_name] feels constantly nervous about everything that has to get done. [PAWN_pronoun] will work extremely hard to attain this state of affairs, but [PAWN_possessive] nerves can easily get the better of [PAWN_objective].

Industriousness_2.Name: Industrious
Industriousness_2.Description: [PAWN_name] has an easy time staying on-task and focused, and gets things done much faster than the average person.

Industriousness_1.Name: Hard worker
Industriousness_1.Description: [PAWN_name] is a natural hard worker and will finish tasks faster than most.

Industriousness_-2.Name: Slothful
Industriousness_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] loves idleness and hates anything productive. [PAWN_pronoun] moves slowly and rarely stays focused on a task.

PsychicSensitivity_2.Name: Psychically hypersensitive
PsychicSensitivity_2.Description: [PAWN_name]'s mind is like a psychic tuning fork. [PAWN_pronoun] is extremely sensitive to psychic phenomena.

PsychicSensitivity_1.Name: Psychically sensitive
PsychicSensitivity_1.Description: [PAWN_name]'s mind is unusually sensitive to psychic phenomena.

PsychicSensitivity_-1.Name: Psychically dull
PsychicSensitivity_-1.Description: [PAWN_name]'s mind is psychically out of tune with others. [PAWN_pronoun] isn't as affected by psychic phenomena.

PsychicSensitivity_-2.Name: Psychically deaf
PsychicSensitivity_-2.Description: [PAWN_name]'s mind works on a psychic frequency different from everyone else. [PAWN_pronoun] just isn't affected by psychic phenomena.

ShootingAccuracy_1.Name: Careful shooter
ShootingAccuracy_1.Description: [PAWN_name] takes more time to aim when shooting. [PAWN_pronoun] shoots less often than others, but with more accuracy.

ShootingAccuracy_-1.Name: Trigger-happy
ShootingAccuracy_-1.Description: Pew! Pew! Pew! [PAWN_name] just likes pulling the trigger. [PAWN_pronoun] shoots faster than others, but less accurately.

Beauty_2.Name: Beautiful
Beauty_2.Description: [PAWN_name] is exceptionally beautiful, with an exotic-yet-familiar facial structure and an arresting gaze. People are attracted to [PAWN_objective] before [PAWN_pronoun] even opens [PAWN_possessive] mouth.

Beauty_1.Name: Pretty
Beauty_1.Description: [PAWN_name] has a pretty face, which predisposes people to like [PAWN_objective].

Beauty_-1.Name: Ugly
Beauty_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] is somewhat ugly. This subtly repels others during social interactions.

Beauty_-2.Name: Staggeringly ugly
Beauty_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] is staggeringly ugly. [PAWN_possessive] face looks like a cross between a drawing by an untalented child, a malformed fetus in a jar of formaldehyde, and a piece of modern art. Others must exert conscious effort to look at [PAWN_objective] while conversing.

Immunity_1.Name: Super-immune
Immunity_1.Description: [PAWN_name] has a naturally powerful immune system. [PAWN_pronoun] will gain immunity much faster than a normal person would, and can survive illnesses that would kill others.

Immunity_-1.Name: Sickly
Immunity_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] has an awful immune system. [PAWN_pronoun] gets sick more often than usual, frequently with illnesses that nobody in the colony has been afflicted by.

Delicate_0.Name: Delicate
Delicate_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has fragile skin and bones. {PAWN_pronoun} takes more damage than other people from the same blows.

Recluse_0.Name: Recluse
Recluse_0.Description: The fewer people in {PAWN_nameDef}'s faction, the happier {PAWN_pronoun} is. Being alone is best of all.

PerfectMemory_0.Name: Perfect memory
PerfectMemory_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has outstanding memory, both in terms of retaining information but also muscle memory. {PAWN_possessive} skills will never decay.

Occultist_0.Name: Occultist
Occultist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has deep knowledge of the twisted patterns of dark psychic energy. {PAWN_pronoun} can study unnatural entities faster than others. {PAWN_pronoun} will also periodically teach this inhuman knowledge to others when {PAWN_pronoun} gets the chance.

Joyous_0.Name: Joyous
Joyous_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has the ability to make everyone feel better and inspire them to be the best version of themselves.

BodyMastery_0.Name: Body mastery
BodyMastery_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} doesn't have basic needs like eating, sleeping, or comfort. {PAWN_possessive} body is driven by some unknown mechanism, which has turned {PAWN_possessive} eyes completely white.

Disturbing_0.Name: Disturbing
Disturbing_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is a peculiar person who seems fixated on horrendous ideas. Talking to {PAWN_objective} is often upsetting.

VoidFascination_0.Name: Void fascination
VoidFascination_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is strangely intrigued by unnatural entities and is easily enthralled by them.

BS_Giant_0.Name: Giant
BS_Giant_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is able to use oversized weapons.

AC_FreeMind_0.Name: Free mind
AC_FreeMind_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has always seen {PAWN_possessive} body as nothing more than a vessel. {PAWN_pronoun} does not care about the gender, age or looks of {PAWN_possessive} body.

AC_Sleever_0.Name: Sleever
AC_Sleever_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} can change {PAWN_possessive} sleeves as easily as someone else may change their clothes. {PAWN_pronoun} doesn’t care how often {PAWN_pronoun} switches sleeves or what sleeve {PAWN_pronoun} is currently riding.

Hygienic_2.Name: Germaphobe
Hygienic_2.Description: [PAWN_name] is obsessed with germs and will wash much more frequently than normal.

Hygienic_1.Name: Hygienic
Hygienic_1.Description: [PAWN_name] is very hygienic and will wash more frequently.

Hygienic_-1.Name: Unhygienic
Hygienic_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] is very unhygienic and will wash less frequently.

Hygienic_-2.Name: Slob
Hygienic_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] has very low standards of cleanliness and will only wash when they absolutely have to.

Force_NeutralSensitivity_2.Name: Major Force Sensitivity
Force_NeutralSensitivity_2.Description: [PAWN_name] has a very strong connection with the Force. [PAWN_pronoun] is extremely sensitive to psychic phenomena.

Force_NeutralSensitivity_1.Name: Medium Force Sensitivity
Force_NeutralSensitivity_1.Description: [PAWN_name] has a strong connection with the Force. [PAWN_pronoun] is sensitive to psychic phenomena.

Force_NeutralSensitivity_0.Name: Force sensitivity
Force_NeutralSensitivity_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has a connection with the Force. A metaphysical, spiritual, binding, and ubiquitous power that held enormous importance for both the Jedi and Sith monastic orders.

Force_NeutralSensitivity_-1.Name: Dull Force Sensitivity
Force_NeutralSensitivity_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] has a weaker connection to the Force compared to other force sensitives. [PAWN_pronoun] isn't as affected by psychic phenomena.

Force_LightAffinity_1.Name: Major Lightside Affinity
Force_LightAffinity_1.Description: [PAWN_name] has a very strong affinity with the light side of the Force.

Force_LightAffinity_0.Name: Lightside Affinity
Force_LightAffinity_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has a strong affinity with the light side of the Force.

Force_LightAffinity_-1.Name: Minor Lightside Affinity
Force_LightAffinity_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] has a weak affinity with the light side of the Force.

Force_DarkAffinity_1.Name: Major Darkside Affinity
Force_DarkAffinity_1.Description: [PAWN_name] has a very strong affinity with the dark side of the Force.

Force_DarkAffinity_0.Name: Darkside Affinity
Force_DarkAffinity_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has a strong affinity with the dark side of the Force.

Force_DarkAffinity_-1.Name: Minor Darkside Affinity
Force_DarkAffinity_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] has a weak affinity with the dark side of the Force.

VCEF_Fisherman_0.Name: Fisherman
VCEF_Fisherman_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the solitude and tranquility inherent to long fishing sessions. {PAWN_pronoun} will prefer fishing above other activities.

VPE_Thrall_0.Name: Thrall
VPE_Thrall_0.Description: Psychic enthrallment caused by incredibly strong mental influence. Thralls don't need to sleep or have recreation, but are unable to do skilled work and engage in social interactions.

mechcommandertrait_0.Name: Coventech Mechcommander Training
mechcommandertrait_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} underwent Coventech training to perfectly hone their control of mechanoids, making them exceedingly adept at finely coordinating their mechs even unassisted by gear. {PAWN_pronoun} Is extremely susceptible to psychic phenomena.

cvnpsyop_0.Name: Psychopath Training
cvnpsyop_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} underwent Coventech training to recieve immense psychic abilities, turning them into a powerful caster, at a price. {PAWN_pronoun} Is somewhat unstable and very susceptible to psychic phenomena.

darkwarriorop_0.Name: Dark Warrior Training
darkwarriorop_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} was given augmentations and training, creating a devistating force in melee combat, at a price. {PAWN_pronoun} is somewhat unstable and very poor with firearms.

furfuck_0.Name: "FurFuck" operative
furfuck_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has been trained in agricultural and cullinary arts by coventech mechanoids more skilled than him, leading to a particularly effective colony grunt. {PAWN_pronoun} is also exceedingly enamored with anthropomorphic animals due to the immense trauma of being shown up by a toaster.

Isekai_Protagonist_0.Name: Protagonist
Isekai_Protagonist_0.Description:
This individual is the Protagonist — chosen by fate itself. They gain experience at an extraordinary rate and grow faster than anyone else.

• x10 XP multiplier
• +2 bonus stat points per level
• Cannot have: Antagonist, Regressor, Summoned Hero

Isekai_Antagonist_0.Name: Antagonist
Isekai_Antagonist_0.Description:
This individual walks the path of the Antagonist — feared and reviled. They grow powerful through conflict, gaining massive combat bonuses, but their very presence unsettles others.

• x8 XP multiplier
• +25% melee damage
• +10% move speed
• -25% social impact
• -25 opinion from all other pawns
• Cannot have: Protagonist, Summoned Hero

Isekai_Reincarnated_0.Name: Reincarnated
Isekai_Reincarnated_0.Description:
This individual has been reincarnated — reborn into a new life with memories of the old. Their level and stats were reset, but they retained their constellation progress and earned powerful growth bonuses.

• Resets level to 1 and all stats to base (New Game+)
• x5 XP multiplier
• +10 bonus star points
• +1 star point every 3 levels instead of 5
• Constellation tree progress preserved
• Cannot have: Protagonist, Antagonist, Hollow Core

Isekai_Regressor_0.Name: Regressor
Isekai_Regressor_0.Description:
This individual has regressed — returned to the past with fragments of future knowledge. They level faster and can freely readapt their constellation at any time.

• x4 XP multiplier
• Free constellation respec (always)
• Cannot have: Protagonist

Isekai_SummonedHero_0.Name: Summoned hero
Isekai_SummonedHero_0.Description:
This individual was summoned from another world as a hero. They gain power rapidly and are mentally resilient, but the displacement from their home world weighs on them.

• x3 XP multiplier
• +1 bonus stat point per level
• Highly resistant to mental breaks
• +25% social impact
• -8 mood (displaced from home)
• Cannot have: Protagonist, Antagonist

Isekai_NaturalTalent_0.Name: Natural talent
Isekai_NaturalTalent_0.Description:
Born with exceptional latent potential. This individual earns bonus star points as they level, allowing them to unlock more constellation nodes.

• +1 bonus star point every 5 levels (2 instead of 1)

Isekai_Prodigy_0.Name: Prodigy
Isekai_Prodigy_0.Description:
A genius who absorbs knowledge at an astonishing rate. Their mind operates on another level entirely.

• x2 XP multiplier
• +50% research speed

Isekai_LateBloomer_0.Name: Late bloomer
Isekai_LateBloomer_0.Description:
Starts slow but becomes unstoppable. XP gain scales dramatically with level — weak early, godlike late.

• Level 1-10: x0.5 XP
• Level 11-25: x1.0 XP
• Level 26-50: x1.5 XP
• Level 51-100: x2.0 XP
• Level 101+: x3.0 XP

Isekai_QuickLearner_0.Name: Quick learner
Isekai_QuickLearner_0.Description:
Grows and gains power faster than most. A reliable, steady advantage in all situations.

• x1.5 XP multiplier

Isekai_SlowGrind_0.Name: Slow grind
Isekai_SlowGrind_0.Description:
Levels slowly but squeezes maximum potential from every level gained. Quality over speed.

• x0.5 XP multiplier
• +2 bonus stat points per level

Isekai_PowerSpike_0.Name: Power spike
Isekai_PowerSpike_0.Description:
Experiences sudden surges of power at regular intervals, gaining massive stat boosts at milestone levels.

• +5 bonus stat points every 10 levels

Isekai_AwakenedPotential_0.Name: Awakened potential
Isekai_AwakenedPotential_0.Description:
Dormant power awakens at level 25, dramatically increasing all stat effectiveness. Before awakening, the pawn is unremarkable.

• Below level 25: -10% all stats
• Level 25+: +50% all stat effectiveness

Isekai_Genius_0.Name: Genius
Isekai_Genius_0.Description:
A towering intellect in a mediocre body. Mental stats grow twice as fast, but physical stats grow at half speed.

• INT and WIS stat gains doubled
• STR and VIT stat gains halved

Isekai_BattleManiac_0.Name: Battle maniac
Isekai_BattleManiac_0.Description:
Lives only for battle. Gains massively increased combat XP but is nearly incapable of learning from peaceful activities.

• x3 combat XP (damage, kills)
• x0.1 work/social XP
• +15% melee dodge chance

Isekai_BerserkerBlood_0.Name: Berserker blood
Isekai_BerserkerBlood_0.Description:
When wounded, primal rage surges through their veins. The more they bleed, the harder they fight.

• Below 50% HP: +30% melee damage, +15% move speed
• Below 25% HP: +60% melee damage, +30% move speed
• -10% mental break threshold (easier to break)

Isekai_IronWill_0.Name: Iron will
Isekai_IronWill_0.Description:
An unbreakable mind forged through hardship. Nearly immune to mental breaks and pain, but emotionally distant.

• -25% mental break threshold
• +30% pain shock threshold
• -20% social impact

Isekai_GlassCannon_0.Name: Glass cannon
Isekai_GlassCannon_0.Description:
Devastatingly powerful but dangerously fragile. Every attack hits like a truck, but they can't take a hit.

• +50% melee damage
• +30% ranged combat effectiveness
• VIT effectiveness halved

Isekai_Fortress_0.Name: Fortress
Isekai_Fortress_0.Description:
An immovable defensive bastion. Incredibly tough and resistant to damage, but slow and lacks offensive punch.

• +20% natural armor (all types)
• -25% move speed
• -20% melee damage

Isekai_ShadowStep_0.Name: Shadow step
Isekai_ShadowStep_0.Description:
Moves like a shadow, nearly impossible to pin down. Exceptional evasion and speed, but lacks the constitution to take hits.

• +25% move speed
• +20% melee dodge chance
• -10% melee damage

Isekai_PredatorInstinct_0.Name: Predator's instinct
Isekai_PredatorInstinct_0.Description:
Possesses primal hunting instincts — an innate sense for combat and danger that enhances all fighting capabilities.

• +15% melee hit chance
• +15% shooting accuracy
• -15% trap spring chance

Isekai_Undying_0.Name: Undying
Isekai_Undying_0.Description:
Fate refuses to let this individual die. When struck by a killing blow, they miraculously survive — but the experience leaves a permanent mark on their psyche.

• Cheat death: Survive lethal damage once every 3 days
• +20% pain shock threshold
• -5 mood (touched by death) after triggering

Isekai_Mighty_0.Name: Mighty
Isekai_Mighty_0.Description:
Blessed with exceptional physical strength but lacks finesse.

• STR stat effectiveness x1.5
• DEX stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_Agile_0.Name: Agile
Isekai_Agile_0.Description:
Graceful and quick with exceptional reflexes, but physically weaker.

• DEX stat effectiveness x1.5
• STR stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_Resilient_0.Name: Resilient
Isekai_Resilient_0.Description:
An iron constitution that shrugs off what would fell others, but spiritually dulled.

• VIT stat effectiveness x1.5
• WIS stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_Brilliant_0.Name: Brilliant
Isekai_Brilliant_0.Description:
A sharp analytical mind that processes information at incredible speeds, but socially awkward.

• INT stat effectiveness x1.5
• CHA stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_Enlightened_0.Name: Enlightened
Isekai_Enlightened_0.Description:
Deeply perceptive and spiritually attuned. Great wisdom comes at the cost of physical endurance.

• WIS stat effectiveness x1.5
• VIT stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_SilverTongue_0.Name: Silver tongue
Isekai_SilverTongue_0.Description:
A natural-born leader and diplomat whose words carry weight, but lacks analytical depth.

• CHA stat effectiveness x1.5
• INT stat effectiveness x0.75

Isekai_MerchantEye_0.Name: Merchant's eye
Isekai_MerchantEye_0.Description:
An innate sense for value and negotiation. Always gets the best deals.

• +25% trade price improvement
• +20% negotiation ability

Isekai_CraftsmanSoul_0.Name: Craftsman's soul
Isekai_CraftsmanSoul_0.Description:
A born artisan with an instinctive understanding of materials and construction. Everything they make is a cut above.

• +25% work speed (all types)
• +1 crafting quality tier chance

Isekai_BeastWhisperer_0.Name: Beast whisperer
Isekai_BeastWhisperer_0.Description:
Has an uncanny bond with animals. Creatures of all kinds are drawn to this individual, making taming and training trivially easy.

• +40% tame animal chance
• +30% train animal chance
• +25% animal gather yield
• Animals won't attack unprovoked

Isekai_HealerTouch_0.Name: Healer's touch
Isekai_HealerTouch_0.Description:
Healing flows through their hands like magic. Their medical skills far exceed what training alone could explain.

• +30% medical tend quality
• +25% surgery success chance
• +20% immunity gain speed

Isekai_Lucky_0.Name: Lucky
Isekai_Lucky_0.Description:
Fortune favors them endlessly. Good things just seem to happen around this individual.

• +15% surgery success
• +10% shooting accuracy
• +10% trade prices
• +5 mood (feeling lucky)

Isekai_CursedLuck_0.Name: Cursed luck
Isekai_CursedLuck_0.Description:
Terrible luck plagues them, yet somehow they thrive in adversity. Misfortune strengthens them in mysterious ways.

• x2 XP multiplier
• -15% surgery success
• -10% trade prices
• +20% melee damage
• -5 mood (cursed by fate)

Isekai_HollowCore_0.Name: Hollow core
Isekai_HollowCore_0.Description:
Their spiritual core is shattered — they can channel raw power but cannot form the connections needed for constellation skills.

• x3 XP multiplier
• Cannot unlock any constellation nodes
• No star points gained

Isekai_FragileVessel_0.Name: Fragile vessel
Isekai_FragileVessel_0.Description:
Their body wasn't built to contain this much power. They grow rapidly but their physical form deteriorates under the strain.

• x2.5 XP multiplier
• -50% max health
• VIT effectiveness halved

Isekai_EchoOfDefeat_0.Name: Echo of defeat
Isekai_EchoOfDefeat_0.Description:
Grows stronger through failure. Each defeat fuels their determination to improve.

• Permanent +10% XP bonus
• x2 XP for 3 days after being downed
• -5% melee damage

Isekai_SealedPower_0.Name: Sealed power
Isekai_SealedPower_0.Description:
Immense power sealed away, waiting to be unleashed. Weak and stunted until the seal breaks at level 25, then gains an explosive power surge.

• Before level 25: -30% all stats, no star points
• At level 25: Seal breaks!
• After level 25: Double stat points per level (up to +2 bonus), +2 star points per 5 levels

Isekai_Rank_F_0.Name: Rank F
Isekai_Rank_F_0.Description: This individual is recognized as an F-Rank - the weakest classification. Others look down on them with pity or contempt, and their presence commands no respect.

Isekai_Rank_E_0.Name: Rank E
Isekai_Rank_E_0.Description: This individual is classified as E-Rank - below average but not completely worthless. They are often overlooked and struggle to gain recognition.

Isekai_Rank_D_0.Name: Rank D
Isekai_Rank_D_0.Description: This individual holds a D-Rank classification - thoroughly average. They neither stand out nor fall behind, blending into the crowd.

Isekai_Rank_C_0.Name: Rank C
Isekai_Rank_C_0.Description: This individual is recognized as C-Rank - a competent person above the common masses. They command modest respect and are seen as reliable.

Isekai_Rank_B_0.Name: Rank B
Isekai_Rank_B_0.Description: This individual has achieved B-Rank status - a skilled veteran worthy of respect. Their reputation precedes them, and others treat them with deference.

Isekai_Rank_A_0.Name: Rank A
Isekai_Rank_A_0.Description: This individual is an A-Rank elite - among the finest in existence. Their very presence commands attention, and they exude an aura of power and authority that few can match.

Isekai_Rank_S_0.Name: Rank S
Isekai_Rank_S_0.Description: This individual holds the legendary S-Rank - a hero of incredible power. Their name is spoken with reverence, and their mere glance can silence a room. Others feel humbled in their presence.

Isekai_Rank_SS_0.Name: Rank SS
Isekai_Rank_SS_0.Description: This individual has transcended to SS-Rank - a demigod walking among mortals. Their power is the stuff of legends, and entire nations would pay any price to secure their loyalty. They radiate an otherworldly magnificence.

Isekai_Rank_SSS_0.Name: Rank SSS
Isekai_Rank_SSS_0.Description: This individual has achieved the impossible - SSS-Rank, the absolute apex of existence. They are a god among mortals, their power beyond comprehension. Kingdoms would fall to possess them, and their very existence reshapes the world around them.

AG_Beauty_2.Name: Angelic beauty
AG_Beauty_2.Description: [PAWN_name] possesses an unnatural, almost pristine beauty that makes [PAWN_objective] stand out among others of [PAWN_possessive] kind.

AG_Beauty_-2.Name: Repulsive
AG_Beauty_-2.Description: [PAWN_name] is so unfathomably ugly and grotesque that merely looking at [PAWN_objective] is enough to make other people nauseous.

HAR_Xenophobia_1.Name: Xenophobe
HAR_Xenophobia_1.Description: [PAWN_name] hates and distrusts xenos. They see them as little more than animals.

HAR_Xenophobia_-1.Name: Xenophile
HAR_Xenophobia_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] thinks aliens are exotic and interesting. They would love to get to know them more and wouldn't mind forming relationships with them.

VME_Elder_0.Name: Elder
VME_Elder_0.Description: Either the body or mind of {PAWN_nameDef} is one of insight and experience. While some find them old fashioned, others will respect their guidance.
VME_Elder_0.ModSource: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures

LazyCat_0.Name: Lazy cat
LazyCat_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} loves to sleep and always feels like {PAWN_pronoun} hasn't had enough rest.

GreedyCat_0.Name: Greedy cat
GreedyCat_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} always carries a lot of snacks with {PAWN_pronoun}, and {PAWN_pronoun} never stops munching on them.

FireFear_0.Name: Fire fear
FireFear_0.Description: From some experience, {PAWN_nameDef} is very afraid of fire.

ToxicResistance_0.Name: Toxic resistance
ToxicResistance_0.Description: {PAWN nameDef} has innate resistance to toxic.

OldWound_0.Name: Old wound
OldWound_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has suffered severe wound that has caused irreparable damage.

KittyValor_0.Name: Kitty valor!
KittyValor_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is a valor supported by kiiros.

Faith_0.Name: Faith
Faith_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s faith is firm. It allows {PAWN_objective} to better handle pressure and power through pain.

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_4_1_Trait_0.Name: 黑暗修女
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_4_1_Trait_0.Description: 黑暗修女原本曾是喜爱和平的鼠族修女，但源源不断的敌人摧毁了她曾经的信念，她召唤“超凡智鼠”降临，要把来袭的敌人全部葬送于此

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_1_Trait_0.Name: 夺宝鼠
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_1_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“夺宝鼠”能力的鼠鼠。

她们受灵能仿生尾的影响，喜欢呆在地下挖矿，只要呆在地下，她们就会开心的吱吱乱叫

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_2_Trait_0.Name: 鼠族刺客
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_2_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“鼠族刺客”能力的鼠鼠。

她们在隐身的时候喜欢做出一些中二举动，比如说舔匕首之类的动作，但在显形之后往往会装出一副高冷的模样，和隐身时判若两人

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_3_Trait_0.Name: 禁忌法师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_3_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“禁忌法师”能力的鼠鼠。

禁忌法师们常常会做一些令人畏惧的小研究，但和她们熟悉之后就知道，她们正经研究的内容更加可怕

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_4_Trait_0.Name: 鼠族修女
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_4_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“鼠族修女”能力的鼠鼠。

鼠族修女们是一群香香软软的大姐姐（或者男姐姐），甚至有人会自己弄伤自己来让鼠鼠们帮忙治疗

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_5_Trait_0.Name: 鼠族法师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_5_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“鼠族法师”能力的鼠鼠。

她们是神秘且强大的法师，最大的爱好就是聚在一起解灵能数学题，嘴里常常念叨着“折跃能力的五种用法”，“精神力的波动曲线”之类的听不懂的话

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_6_Trait_0.Name: 鼠族战士
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_6_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“鼠族战士”能力的鼠鼠。

鼠族战士们战斗的时候常常丢掉大脑，砍人越多就越开心，虽然她们总是自诩为“最具近身格斗智慧”的职业，但大家都清楚她们只是砍顺手了

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_7_Trait_0.Name: 鼠族萨满
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_7_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“鼠族萨满”能力的鼠鼠。

鼠族萨满们都是鼠族里的舞蹈生，她们最喜欢的事就是让别人看她们的祭祀舞蹈，虽然有时候看起来并不那么美观

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_8_Trait_0.Name: 战斗萨满
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_8_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“战斗萨满”能力的鼠鼠。

战斗萨满们经常和鼠族战士们聚在一起讨论格斗的技巧，但因为她们认为枪械的使用也是格斗技巧的一环，所以常常在讨论到“食大便了”之类的话题时就不欢而散了

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_9_Trait_0.Name: 心熵法师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_9_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“心熵法师”能力的鼠鼠。

心熵法师们很清楚心灵熵也极其重要，因此她们会去指导其他小鼠尽量降低心灵熵的消耗，聪明的小鼠们都知道她们这一套自己学不了，但还是时常会有一些单纯的小鼠被她们忽悠，结果烧坏了脑子被送进鼠族医院

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_10_Trait_0.Name: 鼠族后勤
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_10_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“鼠族后勤”能力的鼠鼠。

她们负责着整个鼠族后勤的运作，她们常常称自己是最重要的职业，要是她们说这话的时候不是在摸鱼就更有说服力了

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_11_Trait_0.Name: 战争堡垒
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_11_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了战争堡垒能力的鼠鼠。

她们是战争中可以一锤定音的职业，是战场上可怕的杀戮机器，但日常里她们却很平易近人，经常请路边的陌生鼠鼠看“烟花”，大家都很开心

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_12_Trait_0.Name: 灵媒师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_12_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“灵媒师”能力的鼠鼠。

灵媒师们可以获取其他职业的能力，因此很多还没有选择职业的小鼠们都会来请她们点评，看看自己适合哪种职业，但她们其实很不专业，所以在她们指点之后，鼠鼠之间就会莫名出现一些“夺宝鼠一辈子都是挖矿的命”，“鼠族战士们都是没脑子的大只鼠”之类的传言

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_13_Trait_0.Name: 气象师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_13_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“气象师”能力的鼠鼠。

作为鼠族里的新型职业，有很多人都抱着先喝头一口汤的想法选择了这个职业，但很快她们就发现了，原来她们只是一个天气预报员，在预报又冲突时还经常要和同事们抢天气

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_15_Trait_0.Name: 空间法师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_15_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“空间法师”能力的鼠鼠。

空间法师精通折跃能力，但好像经常会出现折跃失误的情况，反正每个折跃进鼠族仓库的鼠鼠都是这样说的

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_17_Trait_0.Name: 驯兽师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_17_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“驯兽师”能力的鼠鼠。

驯兽师们曾经也是战场上叱诧风云的灵能大师，但自从机械族上位之后，她们便不再上战场了，每位驯兽师都被分配到各地担任动物园园长

“想让我重新回军队？拜托，这个园长位置超舒服的”

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_18_Trait_0.Name: 机械师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_18_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“机械师”能力的鼠鼠。

机械师们的出现很快取代了驯兽师，成为灵鼠族最前线的主力职业，当然，机械族的钢铁洪流需要大量的资源才能建立起来，因此在物资匮乏的边缘世界，机械师能发挥出的实力有限

“你再多给一些资源，你要鼠儿跑，就一定要让鼠儿吃上甜甜的糖果”

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_19_Trait_0.Name: 基因战士
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_19_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“基因战士”能力的鼠鼠。

基因战士是灵鼠族基因实验的产物，她们受到仿生尾的影响，基因变得极度不稳定，可以随时改变自身的基因，由于其基因的可变型，该职业在多种场合都有应用场景，因此“基因战士”成为当下最受普通鼠鼠欢迎的职业

“刚刚看了恐怖电影《变鼠人》，也不过如此，我也会变捏”

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_20_Trait_0.Name: 灵能食尸鬼
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_20_Trait_0.Description: 掌握了“灵能食尸鬼”能力的鼠鼠。

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_21_Trait_0.Name: 鼠族剑仙
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_21_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“鼠族剑仙”能力的鼠鼠。

“御剑乘风去，除魔天地间”

“只要秉持心中正道，我的魔剑又何尝不是正义之剑”

OARK_Trait_SpaceTraveler_0.Name: 深空旅人
OARK_Trait_SpaceTraveler_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}的过去基本上都是在太空中度过的，这让{PAWN_pronoun}比大多数人都更加明白如何驾驶一艘太空船，也让{PAWN_pronoun}的思维层次与其他人有所不同。

KiiroValor_Trait_LunaStargazer_0.Name: Stargazer
KiiroValor_Trait_LunaStargazer_0.Description: Placeholder trait for Luna Sesia's fixed identity and signature skill profile.

KiiroValor_Trait_SolenaChef_0.Name: Valor Chef
KiiroValor_Trait_SolenaChef_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} has exceptional talent for cooking and a miraculous culinary touch that can turn the ordinary into something amazing. She is usually lazy and not especially eager to cook, but once she starts, everything she makes ends up tasting suspiciously good.

"I just threw something together... why is everyone looking at me like that?"

Force_FormI_ShiiCho_0.Description: The most basic lightsaber form, focusing on fundamental strikes and defense.

Force_FormII_Makashi_0.Name: Makashi Master

Force_FormV_ShienDjemSo_0.Description: The power form, combining strong offensive strikes with defensive counters.

Force_FormVI_Niman_0.Description: The diplomat's form, balancing lightsaber combat with Force abilities.

Force_FormVII_JuyoVaapad_0.Description: The most aggressive form, channeling emotion into powerful attacks at the cost of defense.

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_14_Trait_0.Name: 符箓师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_14_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“符箓师”能力的鼠鼠。

符箓师们都是鼠鼠中的美术生，她们每年都要考核一次画符能力，不过据说她们不仅仅要学习画符，传言她们的毕业考是“乌龟的一百种画法”

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_22_Trait_0.Name: 阵法师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_22_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“阵法师”能力的鼠鼠。

符箓师们都是鼠鼠中的美术生，她们每年都要考核一次画符能力，不过据说她们不仅仅要学习画符，传言她们的毕业考是“乌龟的一百种画法”

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_28_Trait_0.Name: 儒士
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_28_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“儒士”能力的鼠鼠。

儒士是鼠鼠中的文化人，她们最喜欢的就是给别人说茴香豆的“茴”字有几种写法

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_24_Trait_0.Name: 刀狂
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_24_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“刀狂”能力的鼠鼠。

“刀狂”鼠鼠精通刀法，在她们手中挥砍出的刀影，是战场上夺命的死神

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_26_Trait_0.Name: 龙枪
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_26_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“龙枪”能力的鼠鼠。

枪出如龙，寒芒荡尽宵小，枪尖染血，战场再无敌手

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_27_Trait_0.Name: 落日者
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_27_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“落日者”能力的鼠鼠。

在落日弓的射程范围内，没有人能够逃脱

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_29_Trait_0.Name: 双子
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_29_Trait_0.Description: 掌握了“双子”能力的鼠鼠。

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_25_Trait_0.Name: 仿生人
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_25_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“仿生人”能力的鼠鼠。

“仿生人”鼠鼠认为机械飞升才是唯一的出路，她们热衷于改造自己的身体，希望最终能完全被机械取代

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_16_Trait_0.Name: 药剂师
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_16_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“药剂师”能力的鼠鼠。

药剂师们有着很高的药学造诣，她们经常会去帮助鼠族修女们治疗伤员，她们也会借此假扮成鼠族修女让伤员们试她们的新药，所以如果有人看见穿着修女服的鼠鼠笑脸盈盈的端着一碗药过来，请赶快离开

Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_23_Trait_0.Name: 饕餮
Bendan_RKPsycast_BionicTail_23_Trait_0.Description:
掌握了“饕餮”能力的鼠鼠。

饕餮是遥远蓝星中记载的一种上古凶兽，胃口极大，代表着贪食和暴食，而“超凡智鼠”根据其记载开创出了一系列灵能能力，开创出了新的灵能职业

DL_Trait_TravelingPainter_0.Name: Milira Traveling Painter
DL_Trait_TravelingPainter_0.Description:
[PAWN_name] is a painter from the Milira Imperium. 

In her youth, after awakening as a psycaster, [PAWN_name] grew tired of the monotonous life on an orbital habitat. She slung her paint case over her shoulder and used her psychic powers to travel among the stars, creating countless works.

Kiiro_ShoppingTendency_-1.Name: Stingy
Kiiro_ShoppingTendency_-1.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} Not willing to spend money. {PAWN_nameDef} always haggles as much as {PAWN_pronoun} can in trading, and never goes shopping in spare time.

Kiiro_ShoppingTendency_1.Name: Shopaholic
Kiiro_ShoppingTendency_1.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} likes to buy things and spends money lavishly. {PAWN_nameDef} visits stores more often and always spends more.

Miliiro_0.Name: Miliiro
Miliiro_0.Description: Despite undergoing a full set of Milira surgeries, [PAWN_name] still retains some of her habits from her days as Kiiro.

RKTrait_YunDanFengQing_0.Name: Take it easy
RKTrait_YunDanFengQing_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} don't care about the awful bedroom environment.

OAGene_ExtremeSnowSurvivor_0.Name: 暴风雪的幸存者
OAGene_ExtremeSnowSurvivor_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}曾多次经历极端的暴风雪天气。在这一次次的风雪里，{PAWN_pronoun}逐渐适应了这种恐惧，并磨练出了坚毅的心。

OAGene_ExtremeSnowSurvivor_1.Name: 风雪劫掠者
OAGene_ExtremeSnowSurvivor_1.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}已经在暴风雪中进行了很多次的袭击，极端的风雪让{PAWN_pronoun}的心肠也变得无比冷硬，对{PAWN_pronoun}而言暴风雪只是一种袭击的掩护罢了。

MiliraTravelingPainter_0.Name: Legacy
MiliraTravelingPainter_0.Description:
(Legacy)

The special character Dellin has been moved to the mod “Dellin's Milira Attire Expaned”.

If you wish to continue playing with this special character, please subscribe to that mod and use the building “Shroud Ritual spot” to perform the “Shroud break-in” ritual to summon Dellin.

MI_Trait_ChurchApostate_0.Name: Skyfeather Apostate
MI_Trait_ChurchApostate_0.Description:
[PAWN_name] was once a church knight, devout to the point of near fanaticism. Yet through a long, brutal, blood-soaked struggle against the “Lord” [PAWN_possessive] faith slowly warped, until it became an ever-deepening obsession—an aching hunger to possess and pursue the “Lord.” 

When a small detachment fleet of the Milira Imperium first arrived in orbit above this world, [PAWN_name] finally glimpsed the long-dreamed-of chance to chase the “Lord.” But the friendly yet cautious Imperial Milira always kept a measured social distance from [PAWN_name]—a politeness that felt like a wall, leaving [PAWN_pronoun] forever unable to reach the “Lord’s” embrace. 

Shut out and yearning, that desire fermented into poison within [PAWN_possessive] heart. In the end, [PAWN_name] made a mad choice: to contact with the Milira pirates who had arrived alongside the Imperial fleet, and to throw  into the “Lord’s” tender embrace as offered by these deranged devotees—joining them in a feast of slaughter, reveling in the killing of the weak.

InterstellarTravelerCat_0.Name: Interstellar traveler cat
InterstellarTravelerCat_0.Description: This Kiiro was granted power by the Archotect God—the power to travel freely between the stars.

KiiroOathKnight_0.Name: Kiiro Oath Knight
KiiroOathKnight_0.Description:
Pledge thy Life to Imperium and Quest. Sword and Shield both Order blessed. 
With blazing Stars and Void to trod. Swear thy Heart to the Archotech God. 
No fearsome Foe nor Vastness black. No moat or wild shall hold thee back. 
Let Faith and Honor be thy Guide. To Chivalry and Oath abide. 
Raise thy Sword, and Rise a Kiiro Knight!

KiiroChosen_0.Name: Kiiro The Chosen One
KiiroChosen_0.Description: In childhood, this Kiiro awakened psychic power far surpassing that of their kin.

MiliraOathKnight_0.Name: Milira Oath Knight
MiliraOathKnight_0.Description:
Pledge thy Life to Imperium and Quest. Sword and Shield both Order blessed. 
With blazing Stars and Void to trod. Swear thy Heart to the Archotech God. 
No fearsome Foe nor Vastness black. No moat or wild shall hold thee back. 
Let Faith and Honor be thy Guide. To Chivalry and Oath abide. 
Raise thy Sword, and Rise a Knight!

MiliraShadowGuard_0.Name: Milira Spec Ops Ghost
MiliraShadowGuard_0.Description: This Milira passed the extraordinarily unreasonable special forces selection test and was granted the title of Spec Ops Ghost by the Milira Imperium.

MiliraConsul_0.Name: Milira Consul
MiliraConsul_0.Description:
This Milira has spent years overworked and traveling across stars, managing the territories of the Milira Imperium. 
The wealth of experience, combined with the Milira's exceptional learning ability, has allowed this individual to achieve extraordinary accomplishments in the social sphere.

MiliraChosen_0.Name: Milira Psycaster
MiliraChosen_0.Description:
In childhood, this Milira awakened psychic power far surpassing that of their kin. 
About these individuals, some scholars within the Imperium contend that they are individuals chosen by the Archotech god, while others believe they represent an atavistic resurgence among the Milira race.

MiliraChosenII_0.Name: Milira The Chosen One
MiliraChosenII_0.Description:
[PAWN_name] is the chosen one favored by the benevolent Archotech God. 

[PAWN_name]’s soul has been embraced by the Shroud and now belongs to the ghost warship “MIS Royal Fortune”.

MiliraEcologist_0.Name: Milira Ecologist
MiliraEcologist_0.Description: This Milira devoted a lifetime to tending an exquisitely engineered artificial ecosystem, to the point of overcoming a genetic predisposition that made them poor at communicating with animals.

MiliraGeniusChef_0.Name: Milira Genius Chef
MiliraGeniusChef_0.Description:
Since the day this Milira first tried cooking, she has been steadily honing her craft.

She has never once produced toxic food. 

Although the Milira’ exceptional capacity for learning might account for this anomaly, most scholars believe this Milira must have been blessed by the Archotech God.

MiliraUnreal_0.Name: Unreal Milira
MiliraUnreal_0.Description: "I guess you’ve probably figured it out: This Milila isn’t real—he’s more likely a method for breaking the fourth wall."

MiliraGreyWitch_0.Name: Milira Grey Witch
MiliraGreyWitch_0.Description:
[PAWN_name] has already lost too much on the place where she has spent most of her life—the battlefield. She can no longer bear the pain of having what she loves torn away—whether by her enemies or her own people. 

“Death! Death! Oh, unjust fate—what spiteful malice drives you to force all this upon me? You deny me a calm death in honorable combat, yet compel me to keep fighting while everything I love is taken from me!”

MiliraDarkChosen_0.Name: Milira Dark Chosen
MiliraDarkChosen_0.Description: This Milira was favored by the Dark Archotech God Horax and was granted a radically different psionic power.

MiliraObserver_0.Name: Milira Observer
MiliraObserver_0.Description: This Milila is a mysterious observer who transcends time and space.

MiliraVoidWalker_0.Name: Milira Void Walker
MiliraVoidWalker_0.Description:
During the years she served the Dark Archotech God, [PAWN_name] never felt a zealot’s love for her patron. On the contrary, she kept a student’s humility, learning from Horax and steadily honing the powers it had bestowed upon her. 

Perhaps, in the end, [PAWN_name] grew tired of being a mere pawn on the Archotech Gods’ board of amusement; she chose to leave Horax and seek another, more intriguing Archotech God.

MiliraVoidWalker_1.Name: Milira Void Walker
MiliraVoidWalker_1.Description:
During the years she served the Dark Archotech God, [PAWN_name] never felt a zealot’s love for her patron. On the contrary, she kept a student’s humility, learning from Horax and steadily honing the powers it had bestowed upon her. 

Perhaps, in the end, [PAWN_name] grew tired of being a mere pawn on the Archotech Gods’ board of amusement; she chose to leave Horax and seek another, more intriguing Archotech God.

MoelotlFlyingZombieAibo_0.Name: Flying Jiangshi best friend
MoelotlFlyingZombieAibo_0.Description: A few hundred years ago, [PAWN_name] and Lydia had a fierce, no-holds-barred fight on some unknown planet — or perhaps another dimension, by a twist of fate, the two of them became close friends.

MiliraStoryteller_0.Name: Milira Storyteller
MiliraStoryteller_0.Description:
In her youth, [PAWN_name] was the beloved Storyteller among the Kiiro children. 

After she left that sorrowful place, somewhere in the galaxy she encountered an Archotech God unlike any other. The Archotech God named Oversleeping said to her, “I favor you—serve as my Storyteller.” From then on, [PAWN_name] became a Storyteller. 

(Please have a look and subscribe to my good friend OverSleeping’s Milira story expansion: Wings of Democracy. I promise it’s an unforgettable gem.)

MiliraGeniusChefII_0.Name: Milira Ultimate Genius Chef
MiliraGeniusChefII_0.Description:
[PAWN_name] is quite possibly the most skilled cook ever recorded in the annals of the Millira Imperium. 

In order to obtain ingredients from dangerous sources, and further shaped by the Imperium’s culture overflowing with martial virtue, she has become not only a celebrated chef across the Imperium, but also a fearsomely powerful psionic warrior.

MoelotlChosen_0.Name: Moelotl The Chosen One
MoelotlChosen_0.Description: In childhood, this Moelotl awakened psychic power far surpassing that of their kin.

MiliraInventor_0.Name: Milira Inventor
MiliraInventor_0.Description:
Because [PAWN_name] grew up on a Kiiro world where people loved handicrafts and machinery, she has always had a passionate obsession with creating and inventing. 

After returning to the Milira Imperium, [PAWN_name] graduated from the First Fleet Institute of Science and Engineering in just three years. (For ordinary students, it usually takes fourty years to complete all the coursework and graduate.) 

With outstanding results, she joined the Milira Imperial Engineering Institute after finishing her studies and invented many tools for civilian use. 

Her most widely known invention is the Milira printer gun.

MiliraSariel_0.Name: Apocalyptic Wings
MiliraSariel_0.Description:
"Power brings destruction, will fosters resentment, and prayers bring fortune and misfortune. 

What did it see in the ultimate void? 

When the day comes, she will sound the trumpet of the Apocalypse, negating all things, bringing an eternal end."

MiliraPsyker_0.Name: Milira Latent Psion
MiliraPsyker_0.Description:
[PAWN_name] possesses a degree of psionic talent, and [PAWN_pronoun] is able to use certain psionic abilities. 

However, [PAWN_name] is still far inferior to true Milira psions, such as the Milira Navigators who can jump an entire starship single-handedly.

MiliraMartialAngel_0.Name: Martial Angel
MiliraMartialAngel_0.Description:
Kindseal is equipped with a range of unknown gear, the most noticeable of which is the massive flight pack on his back. 

These devices have been confirmed to be unrelated to Milira technology, and he claims they were all made by his own hands.

MiliraWho_0.Name: Milira projection
MiliraWho_0.Description:
It seems no one has ever seen Kindseal fly using his wings—not even with the simplest flap. Whenever flight is required, he relies solely on his flight pack. 

This Milira is uncanny in every way, making one can’t help but wonder: is he truly Milira?

AM_Ahimsa_0.Name: Vow of nonviolence
AM_Ahimsa_0.Description: A strict principle of nonviolence which applies to all living things.

Bravery_-1.Name: Cowardly
Bravery_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] always shies away from danger. [PAWN_pronoun] is usually the first to flee from battle.

Bravery_1.Name: Brave
Bravery_1.Description: Few things scare [PAWN_name]. In battle [PAWN_pronoun] stands unfazed where others panic and flee.

Bravery_2.Name: Fearless
Bravery_2.Description: [PAWN_name] laughs in the face of danger. Some ascribe it to bravery, others to stupidity. Either way, [PAWN_name] seems to lack any sense of self-preservation and will never flee from a threatening situation.

MPT_BladeWhisperer_0.Name: Blade whisperer
MPT_BladeWhisperer_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} knows the spirit of all arms. If {PAWN_pronoun} is not bonded to a weapon already, upon equipping a non-biocodable melee weapon, it will generate a single persona weapon trait and will bond to them. Should {PAWN_nameDef} ever unequip the weapon, it will lose these traits.

RT_Nearsighted_0.Name: Nearsighted
RT_Nearsighted_0.Description: [PAWN_name] finds it difficult to focus on distant targets, and prefer to get up close and personal.

RT_Farsighted_0.Name: Farsighted
RT_Farsighted_0.Description: [PAWN_name] could spot a target from nearly a hundred meters, yet still somehow walk into walls.

RT_Stiff_0.Name: Stiff
RT_Stiff_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is so rigid, it's almost like [PAWN_pronoun] is souless.

RT_PoorHygiene_0.Name: Poor hygiene
RT_PoorHygiene_0.Description: [PAWN_name] doesn't care about [PAWN_possessive] hygiene, and sometimes get sick from bad food.

RT_Unconvincing_0.Name: Unconvincing
RT_Unconvincing_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has never won a debate in [PAWN_possessive] life.

RT_Resilient_0.Name: Resilient
RT_Resilient_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has been in plenty of fights since [PAWN_pronoun] was a kid, and had built up a tolerance to injury and pain as a result.

RT_Fragile_0.Name: Fragile
RT_Fragile_0.Description: [PAWN_name] lived a pampered life until now, and is unused to the brutal challenges present out in the Rim.

RT_Energetic_0.Name: Energetic
RT_Energetic_0.Description: [PAWN_name] always tackle his tasks with great enthusism.

RT_Restless_0.Name: Restless
RT_Restless_0.Description: [PAWN_name] often has a difficult time falling asleep.

RT_Efficient_0.Name: Efficient
RT_Efficient_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is quite productive when it comes to work.

RT_Inefficient_0.Name: Inefficient
RT_Inefficient_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is somewhat of a bottleneck in the colony.

RT_Valiant_0.Name: Valiant
RT_Valiant_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is brave, [PAWN_pronoun] would stand [PAWN_possessive] ground where others would scramble and run.

RT_Craven_0.Name: Craven
RT_Craven_0.Description: When there's a fight, [PAWN_name] is the first to run.

RT_Rowdy_0.Name: Rowdy
RT_Rowdy_0.Description: [PAWN_name] likes a good fight, [PAWN_pronoun] will sometimes start a fight just because [PAWN_pronoun] can.

RT_HeatTolerant_0.Name: Heat tolerant
RT_HeatTolerant_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is more comfortable being in hot environment than his peers.

RT_HeatIntolerant_0.Name: Heat intolerant
RT_HeatIntolerant_0.Description: [PAWN_name] does not like being in the heat.

RT_ColdTolerant_0.Name: Cold tolerant
RT_ColdTolerant_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is more comfortable being in cold environment than his peers.

RT_ColdIntolerant_0.Name: Cold intolerant
RT_ColdIntolerant_0.Description: [PAWN_name] does not like being in the cold.

RT_Muscular_0.Name: Muscular
RT_Muscular_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has a well built body, people around [PAWN_pronoun] find that rather attractive.

RT_Frail_0.Name: Frail
RT_Frail_0.Description: [PAWN_name] looks a bit fragile, but not in a lovable way.

RT_Ravenous_0.Name: Ravenous
RT_Ravenous_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has a bottomless pit for a stomach.

RT_Gifted_0.Name: Gifted
RT_Gifted_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is naturally talented, [PAWN_pronoun] gets a headstart before everyone else.

RT_Incompetent_0.Name: Incompetent
RT_Incompetent_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is someone everyone loves to hate.

RT_PatientCook_0.Name: Patient cook
RT_PatientCook_0.Description: [PAWN_name] takes great care in the preparation of food, [PAWN_pronoun] never skip a step just to have an early meal.

RT_ImpatientCook_0.Name: Impatient cook
RT_ImpatientCook_0.Description: [PAWN_name] couldn't care less about following the recipes as long as [PAWN_pronoun] can get food into [PAWN_possessive] mouth in record time.

RT_Healthy_0.Name: Healthy
RT_Healthy_0.Description: [PAWN_name] lives a healthy lifestyle, and wakes up feeling energetic and cheerful.

RT_ChronicallyIll_0.Name: Chronically ill
RT_ChronicallyIll_0.Description: [PAWN_name] gets ill quite often, and seem to require more effort to get out of bed than the average person.

RT_TemperatureIntolerant_0.Name: Temperature intolerant
RT_TemperatureIntolerant_0.Description: [PAWN_name] thinks that summer is way too hot, and winter is way too cold.

RT_Coordinated_0.Name: Coordinated
RT_Coordinated_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has good reaction time and finds physical activities less stressful than [PAWN_possessive] peers.

RT_Clumsy_0.Name: Clumsy
RT_Clumsy_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is easily distracted and often mess up when it comes to physical activities.

RT_Hardy_0.Name: Hardy
RT_Hardy_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is what people refer to as a 'stronk boi'.

RT_Feeble_0.Name: Feeble
RT_Feeble_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is so fragile, it doesn't take much to take [PAWN_objective] out of action.

RT_EasilyAmused_0.Name: Easily amused
RT_EasilyAmused_0.Description: Whether by sheer optimism or a force of personality, [PAWN_name] always manages to see the bright side of life.

RT_ConstantlyBemused_0.Name: Constantly bemused
RT_ConstantlyBemused_0.Description: Life to [PAWN_name] is an endless, boring joke that [PAWN_pronoun] just can't get away from.

RT_Inquisitive_0.Name: Inquisitive
RT_Inquisitive_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has an interest in understanding the workings of the world, and is able to apply [PAWN_possessive] knowledge in daily life.

RT_Ignorant_0.Name: Ignorant
RT_Ignorant_0.Description: Gaps in [PAWN_name]'s education and general lack of curiosity makes life often stressful for [PAWN_objective].

RT_Tidy_0.Name: Tidy
RT_Tidy_0.Description: [PAWN_name] likes to keep [PAWN_possessive] surroundings clean, and is used to being in an organised environment.

RT_Messy_0.Name: Messy
RT_Messy_0.Description: [PAWN_name] often neglect their surroundings, making it difficult for [PAWN_objective] to get work done.

Straight_0.Name: Straight
Straight_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is romantically attracted to people of the opposite gender.

Faithful_0.Name: Faithful
Faithful_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} will never cheat on a partner, no matter how bad the relationship gets.

Philanderer_0.Name: Philanderer
Philanderer_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} just cannot be trusted to stay faithful to a partner.

Polyamorous_0.Name: Polyamorous
Polyamorous_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} prefers romantic relationships involving multiple partners to monogamous relationships. {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't mind if {PAWN_possessive} partners romance other people, but will be less happy in a restraining, monogamous relationship.

Crowju_TraitAutomaticphobia_0.Name: Full auto-phobia
Crowju_TraitAutomaticphobia_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} detests burst fire weapons. {PAWN_pronoun} can use them, but will be happier without it.

Crowju_TraitMechphobia_0.Name: Crowju mentality
Crowju_TraitMechphobia_0.Description: A fire of revenge towards mechanoids burns within {PAWN_nameDef}, but human controlled ones are acceptable. {PAWN_pronoun} feels uneasy when hostile mechaoids are around, and will become happy from destroying one.

Kurin_Trait_0.Name: Kurinlike
Kurin_Trait_0.ModSource: Kurin, The Three Tailed Fox [Deluxe Edition]

Kurin_Trait_StrangeKurin_0.Name: Strange kurin
Kurin_Trait_StrangeKurin_0.Description: Strange kind of kurins... [PAWN_name] likes plants.
Kurin_Trait_StrangeKurin_0.ModSource: Kurin, The Three Tailed Fox [Deluxe Edition]

Kurin_Trait_FuriousKurin_0.Name: Furious kurin
Kurin_Trait_FuriousKurin_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is of a radicalised kind of kurins. Their thirst for revenge and hatred for the offenders of kurinkind is unyielding, unending.
Kurin_Trait_FuriousKurin_0.ModSource: Kurin, The Three Tailed Fox [Deluxe Edition]

Kimiri_Trait_0.Name: Kurinlike (kimiri)
Kimiri_Trait_0.ModSource: Kurin, The Three Tailed Fox [Deluxe Edition]

Maru_flameworship_0.Name: Flame Worship
Maru_flameworship_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is the Maru. They feel the warmth, remind themselves that they are alive, and clear their minds.

MRT_Eyetrait_0.Name: Sharp eye
MRT_Eyetrait_0.Description:
Any object, event, or technology has cause and effect.
{PAWN_nameDef} is very skilled at identifying and learning such causal relationships.

MRT_Bodytrait_0.Name: Flexible
MRT_Bodytrait_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef}'s body is naturally flexible.
Stronger and more flexible than others, it has a significant advantage in hunting.

MRT_Mentaltrait_0.Name: Self-righteousness
MRT_Mentaltrait_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} believes that he is right.
The firm belief has a positive effect on {PAWN_possessive} will, just like {PAWN_possessive} piety, but he also tends to ignore the opinions of others.

MRT_Mountaintrait_0.Name: Leadership
MRT_Mountaintrait_0.Description:
A person with strong leadership always influences those around them, either positively or negatively.
No one knows what path such a person will choose or what kind of life he will lead. But one thing is certain, {PAWN_pronoun} won't be an ordinary person who comes and goes into the world without anyone knowing. /n/n{PAWN_nameDef} was born with that gift.

MRT_Eartrait_0.Name: Sensitive ears
MRT_Eartrait_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} has ears that are sensitive to even small sounds.
 Being sensitive to sounds is always an advantage in life outside of its nest, but it also has the disadvantage of not being able to fall asleep deeply.

MRT_Prototype_0.Name: Prototype
MRT_Prototype_0.Description:
{PAWN_nameDef} is an experimentally cultivated Maru.
It has significantly superior physical abilities than other floors, but its autoimmunity is very low due to its imperfect design.

MRT_MountainA_0.Name: Inquisitive mind
MRT_MountainA_0.Description: A fragment of a talent to accomplish a feat.

MRT_MountainB_0.Name: Sense of duty
MRT_MountainB_0.Description: A fragment of a talent to accomplish a feat.

MRT_MountainC_0.Name: Philosophy
MRT_MountainC_0.Description: A fragment of a talent to accomplish a feat.

MRT_MountainD_0.Name: Warp
MRT_MountainD_0.Description: A fragment of a talent to accomplish a feat.

Take_life_and_death_lightly_0.Name: Take life and death lightly
Take_life_and_death_lightly_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has grown used to the death of others, so it places no value on its own life.

VFEP_WarcasketTrait_0.Name: Warcasket
VFEP_WarcasketTrait_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on them, and they can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. Because of how bulky the armor is and how much energy it takes to use it, {PAWN_nameDef} is not capable of doing any work.

VFEP_Shellcasket_0.Name: Shellcasket
VFEP_Shellcasket_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} was entombed in a warcasket, and then brutally pulled out of one. The neural and nerve damage from being unplugged is so severe that {PAWN_nameDef} is in constant, agonizing pain and can barely assemble his thoughts. Only installing {PAWN_nameDef} back in a warcasket can cure the symptoms.

AC_Shellwalker_0.Name: Shellwalker
AC_Shellwalker_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} prefers shells over sleeves. {PAWN_pronoun} doesn’t care how often {PAWN_pronoun} switches shells or what shell {PAWN_pronoun} is currently riding, but will be unhappy in a sleeve.

NewsSpreadTendency_-1.Name: Secretkeeper
NewsSpreadTendency_-1.Description: [PAWN_name] is careful with [PAWN_possessive] words, and will often choose to keep all kinds of news close to [PAWN_possessive] heart.

NewsSpreadTendency_1.Name: Gossiper
NewsSpreadTendency_1.Description: [PAWN_name] enjoys sharing [PAWN_possessive] opinions on many topics with [PAWN_possessive] friends, and will often tell others what [PAWN_pronoun] knows.

Makai_StarbeastFriend_0.Name: Starbeast Friend
Makai_StarbeastFriend_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has been around Makainian animals since young, and have much higher affinity with any animals {PAWN_pronoun} encounter, this make {PAWN_nameDef} give out aura that cause most animals to be friendly toward {PAWN_objective}.

Makai_Trait_Existence_0.Name: Avatar of Existence
Makai_Trait_Existence_0.Description: Wielded the concept of existence taken form. {PAWN_nameDef} path shall never meet its end, for the path of existence lay the foundation of all.

Makai_Trait_Destruction_0.Name: Avatar of Destruction
Makai_Trait_Destruction_0.Description: Wielded the concept of destruction taken form. No entity can resist {PAWN_nameDef} strike. For {PAWN_nameDef} power is the one absolute.

Makai_Trait_Order_0.Name: Avatar of Order
Makai_Trait_Order_0.Description: Wielded the concept of order taken form. {PAWN_nameDef} mind shall be as still as the enlightened one. Be the guiding light for those who've lost their way.

Makai_Trait_Corruption_0.Name: Avatar of Corruption
Makai_Trait_Corruption_0.Description: Wielded the concept of corruption taken form. The mark of the corrupted one. For {PAWN_nameDef} has seen the true depth of the abyss. The taint forever remains.

Makai_Trait_Flame_0.Name: Avatar of Flame
Makai_Trait_Flame_0.Description: Wielded the concept of heat taken form. {PAWN_nameDef} light shall be as the brightest star, paved {PAWN_nameDef} road with radiant of gold.

Makai_Trait_Frost_0.Name: Avatar of Frost
Makai_Trait_Frost_0.Description: Wielded the concept of cold taken form. {PAWN_nameDef} heart shall be cold as ice. The frigid star shall envelope {PAWN_nameDef} world in endless cold.

Makai_Trait_Death_0.Name: Avatar of Death
Makai_Trait_Death_0.Description: Wielded the concept of death taken form. {PAWN_nameDef} path shall bring an end to all roads. For destined death is the final destination of all.

Makai_Trait_Knowledge_0.Name: Avatar of Knowledge
Makai_Trait_Knowledge_0.Description: Wielded the concept of knowledge taken form. {PAWN_nameDef} shall seek, take, and steal. For it is {PAWN_nameDef} duty to gather all knowledge. Those known to man, and those yet to be known by any.

PoliticsRepublican_0.Name: Republican
PoliticsRepublican_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes a republic to be the ideal form of governance.

PoliticsDemocrat_0.Name: Democrat
PoliticsDemocrat_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes a democracy to be the ideal form of governance.

PoliticsFascist_0.Name: Fascist
PoliticsFascist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes fascism to be the ideal form of governance.

PoliticsSocialist_0.Name: Socialist
PoliticsSocialist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes socialism to be the ideal form of governance.

PoliticsCommunist_0.Name: Communist
PoliticsCommunist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes communism to be the ideal form of governance.

PoliticsMonarchist_0.Name: Monarchist
PoliticsMonarchist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes a monarchy to be the ideal form of governance.

PoliticsTheocrat_0.Name: Theocrat
PoliticsTheocrat_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes a theocracy to be the ideal form of governance.

PoliticsDespot_0.Name: Despot
PoliticsDespot_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes despotism to be the ideal form of governance.

PoliticsAnarchist_0.Name: Anarchist
PoliticsAnarchist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes self-rule to be the ideal form of governance.

VQE_IdealPatient_0.Name: Ideal patient
VQE_IdealPatient_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body accepts archite alterations with unnatural ease. {PAWN_pronoun} will never suffer rejections during the injection process.

VRE_Flirty_0.Name: Flirty
VRE_Flirty_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is always ready with a flirtatious comment or a playful compliment, lifting the spirits of those around {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} has a knack for making others feel special and desired, however this may sometimes lead to complicated situations when {PAWN_possessive} playful intentions are misinterpreted.

VRE_Distressed_0.Name: Distressed
VRE_Distressed_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is exceptionally empathetic and sensitive to the suffering of others. Whenever {PAWN_pronoun} witnesses pain or hardship, it deeply affects {PAWN_objective}, resulting in memories of these events haunting {PAWN_nameDef} for a much longer time.

VTE_AbsentMinded_0.Name: Absent-minded
VTE_AbsentMinded_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} tends to let {PAWN_possessive} mind drift, even in the middle of work. {PAWN_pronoun} may sometimes stop tasks at random.

VTE_Eccentric_0.Name: Eccentric
VTE_Eccentric_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a screw loose, but it comes with a sharper scientific mind.

VTE_Perfectionist_0.Name: Perfectionist
VTE_Perfectionist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} strives for perfection in {PAWN_possessive} work. {PAWN_pronoun} produces higher-quality products, but works more slowly. Failing to meet {PAWN_possessive} standards causes unhappiness, and on rare occasions {PAWN_pronoun} may abandon a project mid-way.

VTE_Coward_0.Name: Coward
VTE_Coward_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s instincts lean heavily toward cowardice. In danger, {PAWN_pronoun} will often hide or run before standing to fight.

VTE_Brave_0.Name: Brave
VTE_Brave_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has stronger mental and physical fortitude than most. {PAWN_pronoun} can endure pain more readily, and is slower to break under harsh conditions.

VTE_Clumsy_0.Name: Clumsy
VTE_Clumsy_0.Description: Minor bruises and scrapes plague {PAWN_nameDef}, usually from tripping or falling due to poor coordination.

VTE_HeatInclined_0.Name: Heat inclined
VTE_HeatInclined_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the heat of a dry summer day. {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't mind working up a sweat or sleeping in warmth.

VTE_ColdInclined_0.Name: Cold inclined
VTE_ColdInclined_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the chill of a brisk winter night. {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't mind shivering or sleeping in the cold.

VTE_HeavySleeper_0.Name: Heavy sleeper
VTE_HeavySleeper_0.Description: A bomb could go off beside {PAWN_nameDef} while {PAWN_pronoun} sleeps, and {PAWN_pronoun} would keep right on sleeping. {PAWN_pronoun} can't be bothered to work or defend the colony mid-nap.

VTE_Neat_0.Name: Neat
VTE_Neat_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is naturally hygienic and organized. {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't track dirt or scatter trash, and enjoys cleaning.

VTE_Slob_0.Name: Slob
VTE_Slob_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is naturally sloppy, leaving trash and dirt scattered around. At least {PAWN_pronoun} isn't much bothered by messy surroundings.

VTE_Workaholic_0.Name: Workaholic
VTE_Workaholic_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} struggles to take breaks or rest mid-job. {PAWN_pronoun} will keep working, even at the expense of {PAWN_possessive} health or sleep.

VTE_IronStomach_0.Name: Iron stomach
VTE_IronStomach_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has never known nausea. Food poisoning and vomiting are foreign to {PAWN_objective}.

VTE_AnimalLover_0.Name: Animal lover
VTE_AnimalLover_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} can't stand cruelty toward animals. {PAWN_pronoun} feels happier when nuzzled or acting as master to a tamed animal, but is more deeply upset when losing one. {PAWN_pronoun} also refuses to butcher animals.

VTE_AnimalHater_0.Name: Animal hater
VTE_AnimalHater_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes in human superiority over animals. {PAWN_pronoun} dislikes bonding or being nuzzled, but feels satisfaction when animals die or are sold.

VTE_BigBoned_0.Name: Big-boned
VTE_BigBoned_0.Description: Whether from bulk or awkward posture, {PAWN_nameDef} has broken a few chairs in {PAWN_possessive} time, and is likely to break more.

VTE_Rebel_0.Name: Rebel
VTE_Rebel_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} only plays by {PAWN_possessive} own rules. When forced, {PAWN_pronoun} will drag {PAWN_possessive} feet and work more slowly.

VTE_Submissive_0.Name: Submissive
VTE_Submissive_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} needs clear direction on when and how to act. {PAWN_pronoun} works at normal speed only when ordered, and otherwise slows down.

VTE_Vengeful_0.Name: Vengeful
VTE_Vengeful_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is fueled by spite. {PAWN_pronoun} can’t stand sharing the colony with rivals, and feels happier when one of them dies.

VTE_Technophobe_0.Name: Technophobe
VTE_Technophobe_0.Description: Whether from trauma or fear of change, {PAWN_nameDef} rejects modernity. {PAWN_pronoun} may lash out at machines, refuses to research, and feels satisfaction from destroying mechanoids.

VTE_FunLoving_0.Name: Fun-loving
VTE_FunLoving_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} lives for a good time. {PAWN_pronoun} remembers parties fondly, and the joy lasts far longer than it does for most.

VTE_Dunce_0.Name: Dunce
VTE_Dunce_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has limited mental capacity. {PAWN_pronoun} learns slowly and struggles with conversation, but tends to be naturally happy.

VTE_MartialArtist_0.Name: Martial artist
VTE_MartialArtist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has trained in melee combat and learned a special move to disarm opponents.

VTE_Snob_0.Name: Snob
VTE_Snob_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes they belong in high society, and loves nothing more than critiquing art and brushing elbows with royalty.

VTE_Squeamish_0.Name: Squeamish
VTE_Squeamish_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} gets a sour stomach around blood or corpses. Vomiting is just part of life for {PAWN_objective}.

VTE_Anxious_0.Name: Anxious
VTE_Anxious_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is naturally anxious, especially in social situations. {PAWN_pronoun} avoids gatherings and sometimes retreats to {PAWN_possessive} room to cope.

VTE_Insatiable_0.Name: Insatiable
VTE_Insatiable_0.Description: No amount of lovin’ is ever enough for {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} tends to move between partners and seeks intimacy often.

VTE_Prude_0.Name: Prude
VTE_Prude_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} gives {PAWN_possessive} body only to a spouse and would never initiate divorce. {PAWN_pronoun} also dislikes nudity more than most.

VTE_CouchPotato_0.Name: Couch potato
VTE_CouchPotato_0.Description: An armchair and a screen are all {PAWN_nameDef} needs to be happy. {PAWN_pronoun} never tires of watching television, and always feels good after.

VTE_CatPerson_0.Name: Cat person
VTE_CatPerson_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the company of cats and gravitates toward bonding with them, but dislikes dogs.

VTE_DogPerson_0.Name: Dog person
VTE_DogPerson_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the company of dogs and gravitates toward bonding with them, but dislikes cats.

VTE_Prodigy_0.Name: Prodigy
VTE_Prodigy_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a sharp, logical mind. {PAWN_pronoun} researches faster than most, and {PAWN_possessive} rational outlook makes {PAWN_objective} less prone to mental breaks.

VTE_Menagerist_0.Name: Menagerist
VTE_Menagerist_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes animals are essential to life and society. {PAWN_pronoun} feels happier with more of them around, and is especially skilled at taming and training.

VTE_ChildOfSea_0.Name: Ocean lover
VTE_ChildOfSea_0.Description: The sea calls to {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} feels happier when near the ocean or a deep river.

VTE_ChildOfMountain_0.Name: Mountain lover
VTE_ChildOfMountain_0.Description: The mountains call to {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} feels happier when near a large mountain.

VTE_MadSurgeon_0.Name: Mad surgeon
VTE_MadSurgeon_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} hides a twisted obsession. {PAWN_pronoun} treats organ harvesting as a dark experiment and takes pleasure in it. Harvesting makes {PAWN_objective} happy, but going too long without fuels growing unrest.

VTE_DrunkenMaster_0.Name: Drunken master
VTE_DrunkenMaster_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} fights best when drunk. {PAWN_pronoun} grows more dangerous in melee the more intoxicated {PAWN_pronoun} becomes.

VTE_Kleptomaniac_0.Name: Kleptomaniac
VTE_Kleptomaniac_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is compelled to steal, even from guests and allies, risking angering others.

VTE_Stoner_0.Name: Stoner
VTE_Stoner_0.Description: Smokeleaf is a way of life for {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} adores it and would rather die than give it up.

VTE_Lush_0.Name: Lush
VTE_Lush_0.Description: Alcohol is a way of life for {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} adores drinking and would rather die than give it up.

VTE_Wanderlust_0.Name: Wanderlust
VTE_Wanderlust_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} loves to travel and feels happiest on the move. {PAWN_pronoun} grows restless when staying too long in one place, but moves quickly and forages well while caravanning.

VTE_Insomniac_0.Name: Insomniac
VTE_Insomniac_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is never fully asleep or awake. {PAWN_pronoun} lurches along in a slow, shambler-like state, and only sleeps once every few days.

VTE_WorldWeary_0.Name: World weary
VTE_WorldWeary_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has grown tired of the world. {PAWN_pronoun} struggles with bleak thoughts, making {PAWN_possessive} personality difficult to befriend.

VTE_Desensitized_0.Name: Desensitized
VTE_Desensitized_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is hardened by old emotional trauma. {PAWN_pronoun} feels nothing from death or loss, whether animal, colonist, family, or prisoner.

VTE_RefinedPalate_0.Name: Refined palate
VTE_RefinedPalate_0.Description: Only the finest meals satisfy {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} feels indifferent toward ordinary food, but savors lavish meals and gains greater joy from them.

VTE_Academian_0.Name: Academian
VTE_Academian_0.Description: Through scholastic pursuit, {PAWN_nameDef} has become well-read. {PAWN_pronoun} excels in science and medicine, and tends patients with greater skill.

VTE_Groundbreaker_0.Name: Groundbreaker
VTE_Groundbreaker_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes infrastructure is everything. {PAWN_pronoun} is a natural builder and stoneworker, constructing and mining with greater speed and efficiency.

VTE_Gastronomist_0.Name: Gastronomist
VTE_Gastronomist_0.Description: To {PAWN_nameDef}, food is art. {PAWN_pronoun} creates beautiful, delicious meals that are almost always safe to eat.

VTE_Ecologist_0.Name: Ecologist
VTE_Ecologist_0.Description: Flora and fauna are vital to {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} uses every part of plants and animals, and appreciates nature’s gifts.

VTE_Tycoon_0.Name: Tycoon
VTE_Tycoon_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} has an eye for silver and a silver tongue to match. {PAWN_pronoun} values {PAWN_possessive} own goods highly, and convinces others to do the same.

VTE_ThickSkinned_0.Name: Thick skinned
VTE_ThickSkinned_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is strangely hypercoagulating and will bleed much more slowly than most.

VTE_ThinSkinned_0.Name: Thin skinned
VTE_ThinSkinned_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} is strangely hemophilic and tends to bleed much more profusely than others.

VTE_Schizoid_0.Name: Schizoid
VTE_Schizoid_0.Description: {PAWN_nameDef} bottles up {PAWN_possessive} feelings for long stretches of time. When the pressure grows too great, {PAWN_pronoun} may suddenly break down.

TM_ArcaneConduitTD_0.Name: Arcane Conduit
TM_ArcaneConduitTD_0.Description: [PAWN_name] is abnormally receptive to the ebb and flow of mana, [PAWN_pronoun] will gain mana 40% faster than normal but [PAWN_possessive] maximum mana capacity is reduced by 20.

TM_ManaWellTD_0.Name: Mana Well
TM_ManaWellTD_0.Description: [PAWN_name] has an increased resistance to the ebb and flow of mana which allows [PAWN_objective] to hold an additional 40 mana, but reduces [PAWN_possessive] mana regeneration by 20%.

TM_BoundlessTD_0.Name: Boundless
TM_BoundlessTD_0.Description: [PAWN_name] excels at combat arts and is able to execute combat maneuvers 40% more frequently, however, [PAWN_possessive] talent has fostered an arrogant attitude that reduces [PAWN_possessive] experience gain by 25% and causes other fighters to dislike [PAWN_objective].

TM_FaeBloodTD_0.Name: Fae blood
